_comment: INTERVIEWS & REVIEWS. Two shelves, deliberately unequal. `quotes` is small and loud — set enormous, one per screen. `clippings` is the ledger: everything else, scannable. Both arrays empty = the /press/ page still builds but drops out of the nav on its own.
_comment_provenance: Everything below was researched and verified by Claire on 2026-09-03 against the live source pages — quotes are VERBATIM and attributed. Dario: cut anything you don't want, and add what I couldn't find. `kind` is Interview / Review / Feature; a fourth category stops the ledger scanning. Added 2026-09-09 from links Dario sent: La Gazzetta del Mezzogiorno (Secret Seas), Cinque Colonne (review + quote, verbatim Italian), Senigallia Notizie (Impurità in the iTunes list, 2012).

quotes.text: I would recommend this book to fans of Terry Pratchett or David Lynch.
Humorous, tragic at heart and, most of all, strangely perceptive.
The best novel I've read in a while, satisfying to the end.
Lo stile di Cannizzaro è – fortunatamente! – unico.
